description: This file defines an enumeration for different campaign types in the Fineract project, including methods to convert from integers and enum instances to option data and to check if the type is SMS.

classes.name: CampaignType
classes.description: Enumeration representing different campaign types such as INVALID, SMS, and NOTIFICATION, with utility methods for conversion and type checking.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an Integer to the corresponding CampaignType enum value, defaulting to INVALID if input is null or unmatched.

methods.name: campaignType
methods.description: Converts an Integer or CampaignType into an EnumOptionData instance representing the campaign type.

methods.name: isSms
methods.description: Returns true if the CampaignType instance is SMS.
